summary: The Voyage board now offers only the active squad's three pilots' jobs (plus the escort and the way home); the rest of the crew no longer fills it to six (DEPTH 14 decision 8). A player with no squad gets a starter squad (Sparrow Charge TALON, Squirrel Mass ANVIL, Dolphin Space CITADEL) saved into their squad book. Shombith's call, 2026-11-16.
